verdict.rationale: Netlify documents serverless functions for building APIs, plus managed databases, built-in identity and global CDN deploys, which together cover full-stack apps without server management. Community users independently confirm 'zero-config Lambda functions' and choosing Netlify so someone else manages the infrastructure. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on function runtimes and limits, explicit first-party evidence for edge functions (only implied via the Turso integration and a community mention), and broader language support (a community report says only JS/TS/Go are available).

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps with no servers to manage

citations.quote: Instantly provision a production-grade database with Netlify Database or use Blobs as a simple key/value store or lightweight database.
They want someone else to manage all those bits.
